test_concat_ignore_index: test concat with ignore_index=True along axis=1 to create a new RangeIndex
test_concat_same_index_names: test concat along axis=1 with DataFrames having same or different index names
test_concat_rename_index: test concat with keys and names to create a MultiIndex with renamed levels
test_concat_multiindex_with_keys: test concat of a DataFrame with itself using keys to prepend a level to MultiIndex
test_concat_multiindex_with_none_in_inde: test concat with MultiIndex containing None names and keys with custom level names
test_concat_with_various_multiindex_dtyp: test concat along axis=1 with MultiIndex columns of various dtypes
test_concat_range_index_result: test concat with sort=True and axis=1 produces a RangeIndex result
test_concat_index_keep_dtype: test concat with ignore_index=True preserves column index dtype
test_concat_index_find_common: test concat finds common dtype when concatenating columns with different nullable integer dtypes
test_concat_axis_1_sort_false_rangeindex: test concat with sort=False along axis=1 preserves RangeIndex column order
